name: Candy Blitz

features.name: Pay anywhere
features.description: Eight or more matching candies anywhere on the 6x5 grid pay.

features.name: Multiplier reel
features.description: A separate reel can multiply wins by up to 500x.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Four scatters trigger the bonus with a minimum 2x multiplier; four more retrigger it.

review:
A 6x5 pay-anywhere candy game: eight or more matching sweets anywhere win, then disappear and cascade for possible chains.

The key feature is a multiplier reel beside the grid that can boost wins by up to 500x. Four scatters trigger free spins, where the minimum multiplier rises to 2x, and four more retrigger. Up to 10,000x, 96.08% RTP. Like Sweet Bonanza, but with the multiplier shown more clearly.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
